name: Hurry or Not Hillarys 2025
information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **There will be no 3x3 at this competition, but with some relaxed time limits, this is the BEST chance to get some big cube results for the first time!** **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au) Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Whadjuk Noongar people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.
